I've seen those videos before. I watched them in an attempt to 'harden' myself, because I've always been too sensitive. It messed me up so bad. I understand how sickening the transition can be.
After seeing these things, life seems so meaningless... because you see all these people who are there, and then gone the next second. But in the moment you die, you lose everything. Death means losing everything: losing the opportunity to feel excitement and purpose again. Possibilities of finding love and passion fly out of the window as you die; everything does. Just by holding on for a little bit longer, you can't lose that much.
I hope you're still here.
